environment: Linux Chromium, actual IndexedDB/BroadcastChannel and anonymous local samples; no real Auth, remote writes or Apple hardware.

checks.name: one local position survives reload; caller mutation cannot alter the saved row
a new source head leaves the exact old version and UTF-16 end position intact
invalid offsets, split surrogate pairs, missing pairs and link-only sources cannot be stored
clearing an empty position stores a revision tombstone that rejects delayed revision-zero captures
two tabs saving from the same revision have exactly one winner
another tab clear and newer save both reject a delayed older candidate without rebasing
a removed exact version remains unavailable until explicit clear; newer text is never substituted
positions are isolated by account, project and workspace; unscoped access is rejected
scope disposal aborts a pending write and its old handle cannot read, save or clear
quota aborts roll back both save and clear without advancing revision or publishing success
save and clear preserve source revisions, pending sync payload, exports and restored-copy isolation
account-scoped notifications contain revision only and other tabs re-read the authoritative state
unknown metadata formats and content-bearing fields are rejected without overwriting their row
